name: Habakkuk
lede: The thirty-fifth book of the Bible, in full: the burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see — O Jehovah, how long shall I cry?; the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation; I will stand upon my watch; write the vision, and make it plain upon tablets — the righteous shall live by his faith; and the prayer of Habakkuk: though the fig-tree shall not flourish, yet I will rejoice in Jehovah — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Watchtower
books.blurb: O Jehovah, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear?; lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, whose horses are swifter than leopards; art not thou from everlasting, O Jehovah my God?; I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower; write the vision, and make it plain upon tablets, that he may run that readeth it — the righteous shall live by his faith; the five woes, and Jehovah in his holy temple; then the prayer of Habakkuk: God came from Teman; though the fig-tree shall not flourish, yet I will rejoice in Jehovah.
